directAnswer.en: This is indoor mortar or plaster spraying. It is not a trailer-pump pour. The hose window is 15 m horizontal / 5 m vertical. A longer indoor run leaves this row. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists Type 311 at 220/380 V, 4 kW, 2 m³/h, 3–5 MPa, 15 m horizontal / 5 m vertical, hose 25 mm, particle ≤2 mm, sand-cement ratio ≤1:3, 1500 × 420 × 900 mm and 150 kg. Do not move the same condition onto Type 511, which prints 380 V, 7.5 kW, 3 m³/h, 3–5 MPa, 30 m horizontal / 15 m vertical, hose 32/38 mm, particle ≤6 mm, sand-cement ratio ≤1:3, 1700 × 550 × 900 mm and 260 kg. The photograph is a working-condition reference from a public article about this kind of work. It is not a Pinjin contract record. This page names no project, no country job, no price and no daily volume.

body.en: Send Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai the material, the largest particle, the sand-cement ratio, the hose length you measured, and whether the site can supply the printed power. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Do not attach a project name, a country job, a price or a daily volume the catalogue does not print.
body.zh: 请把材料、最大粒径、砂灰比、量到的软管长度，以及现场能否按已印动力供电，发给邢台的河北品锦机械。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上目录里没有的项目名称、国家工程、价格或日方量。
